service.description: Internal, for the SupportCaseRule rules of entity/Request.eecas.xml: ensure#CaseProfile after the commit of the change (at once when there is no transaction), as queue#RequestTriage. A failure is logged, never the change's.

Makes a request a support case when the case rule says it is one (SupportCases.js route): submitted, a Customer party of an organization with a current ServicePolicy that serves it, and in one of its service queues or of a type it service-enables (moved into the type's default queue). Makes the CaseProfile (the policy and workflow, the queue, the intake time and the message it came from) and the OrgInternal party. Idempotent: a case stays one. Internal: run by queue#CaseProfile and create#Case; no permission, so every entry point makes its case.

Whether a request is a support case, with its organization, queue and status category; or, with no requestId, whether a request with the fields given would be one (wouldBeCase), as raise#Request asks before it takes a due date. No permission: it names no customer or record.

A case workflow's current status mappings (agent and customer labels, category, order), the default workflow's for a status it does not map, and its moves (CaseTransition). No permission: workflow labels.

Internal, for the SupportCaseCustomerReply rule of entity/Request.eecas.xml: a message filed on a case from its customer, contact or a contact of the customer organization tells the case's assignee on the topic SupportCaseCustomerReply. Not a case, a note or an internal sender: nothing. A failure is logged.

A case for a customer the organization serves, atomically (design NewCase SubmitCase): the Request (create#Request, Submitted, in a service queue of the organization: the one given, else the type's default, else the policy's), its Customer, Reporter (the contact, when given) and OrgInternal parties, the records it is on (link#RequestRecord), its profile (ensure#CaseProfile) and its assignee. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and the organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); refuses a customer it does not serve (CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE), a queue not its (QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE) or not taking the type (TYPE_NOT_OFFERED), an assignee outside the queue's team (ASSIGNEE_UNAVAILABLE) and an organization with no service policy (SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED). P7: the case's template (templateFormId, one of the organization's, else the queue's) takes templateValues, checked by validate#TemplateValues before anything is made (TEMPLATE_VALUES_INVALID, TEMPLATE_UNAVAILABLE) and kept as a FormResponse linked from the profile.

A case's queue, priority and assignee (an empty assigneePartyId unassigns; an absent one leaves it) under its queue (crosscut CaseServiceFacts): another queue of the case's organization (QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE), a priority of 1 to 9, an assignee of the queue's team (ASSIGNEE_UNAVAILABLE), told on SupportCaseAssigned. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT, and SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE for a case assigned to another agent; refuses a closed case (CASE_CLOSED) and, with caseRevision, a case changed since (STALE_CASE).

A case's status by its workflow (CaseTransition rows of the profile's workflow, else the default): resolve (Completed or Cancelled) with a resolution when the move needs one (RESOLUTION_REQUIRED), hold, cancel or reopen with a reason (REASON_REQUIRED, written on its conversation), a manager's move (SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE); reopen within the policy's window (REOPEN_WINDOW_PASSED) and never a closed case (CASE_CLOSED). Any other move is refused (TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED). Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and the case's organization; with caseRevision refuses a case changed since (STALE_CASE).

Adds (mode add, the default), removes or replaces a case's tags (RequestTag rows of the RequestTag enumeration; a removed tag is ended). Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and the case's organization; refuses an unknown tag (TAG_UNKNOWN).
The in-parameters of a dated settings save.

A service queue (design Queues QueueEdit): its category (a new one owned by the organization, or one already its: QUEUE_ORGANIZATION) with name, parent and responsible party, and a ServiceQueue row from its date: the offered types, visibility (a restricted queue needs its team: TEAM_REQUIRED), responsible team (one of the organization's: TEAM_UNAVAILABLE) and fallback assignee (P7: and its template, kept unless templateFormId is given, empty for none). With end, ends the queue's row (not a queue new intake goes to: QUEUE_IN_USE); its cases stay. Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the organization.

A request type as the organization offers it for cases (design CaseTypes ServiceTypes), from its date: service-enabled (needs its default queue, a service queue of the organization: QUEUE_REQUIRED, QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE), the customer label, default priority and workflow, and whether the customer pages offer it. Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the organization.

What a request status means on a case of a workflow (design StatusCategories CaseStatusMap), from its date: the agent's and the customer's labels (LABEL_REQUIRED), the category (CATEGORY_UNKNOWN), whether it needs a reason, and its order. Workflows are shared settings, as status flows are. Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT.

A case workflow (a new one by its description) and, with statusId and toStatusId, one of its moves (design StatusCategories CaseTransitionPolicy) from its date: whether it needs a resolution, a reason or SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE, and whether the customer is told; with end, ends the move. A move must be one of the Default request flow (STATUS_FLOW_MISSING). Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT.

An organization's service policy (design ServiceDefaults ServicePolicy) from its date; its first row turns the case rules on for the organization: the default queue (one of its service queues), workflow, what an unknown sender makes, the reopen window (14 days by default, 0 to 365), the auto-close delay, whether resolving needs a resolution, and customerImmediateCancel (off). Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the organization.
A service team of the organization: a new one (an organization party it owns, in the OrgTeam role) or one of its renamed (TEAM_UNAVAILABLE). Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the organization.

A person joins a service team as an agent (roleTypeId Agent) or its manager (Manager), from a date, by a dated PartyRelationship (PrtServiceTeam); with end, leaves it (the relationship ended, history kept). Needs SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE and to manage the team, or SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT; the team must be one of the user's organizations' (TEAM_UNAVAILABLE) and the member a person (MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE). P5: with participation, the member's participation from its date (eligible for assignment, the most open cases, a substitute who is another member: SUBSTITUTE_UNAVAILABLE, a calendar of the organization, the team or the member: CALENDAR_UNAVAILABLE); the team's user group (its saved replies' audience) follows the members.

parameter.name: participation
parameter.description: The participation fields are given: a current member's membership stays as it is and a new participation row replaces the one in effect

service.description: Runs the case's queue's assignment rules (design AssignmentRules): the first rule whose conditions hold picks an eligible agent of its team by its distribution (round robin, fewest open cases; manual leaves the case), else its fallback, else the queue's fallback, else the case stays unassigned and the queue team's managers are told (SupportCaseUnassigned). The rule's cursor is locked with the assignment. At intake an assigned case stays so; with reassign (a move to another queue) the rule's agent replaces the assignee, or none is left. Records the rule, outcome and reason on the case's profile. The clocks are not touched. Internal: run by ensure#CaseProfile and update#Case; a queue with no rule changes nothing.

What the assignment rules would do (design AssignmentRules AssignmentPreview), through the same evaluator as assign#Case and writing nothing: for a case (requestId), or for a case with the facts given (queue, type, priority, channel, customer, tags) of the organization; with assignmentRuleId, that rule alone (a draft to try). Each rule with its conditions and whether each held, the winning rule's agents with whether each is eligible now and why not (not taking cases, at their most open cases, outside their working hours), the outcome and the agent it would pick. Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT, SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE or SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and the organization.

An assignment rule of a service queue of the organization (design AssignmentRules AssignmentRuleEdit), from its date: a draft has none and changes in place; a change of a published rule is a new row naming the one it replaces, which it ends; with end, ends it. Its queue (QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE), name, order, distribution (DISTRIBUTION_UNKNOWN), team (the queue's by default; TEAM_UNAVAILABLE, TEAM_REQUIRED), the members it takes (MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE), whether working hours count, the most open cases (MAX_LOAD_INVALID), the fallback (ASSIGNEE_UNAVAILABLE) and its typed conditions: the list given (conditions), else the row's with one added, changed or removed (conditionAction add, update or remove, conditionSeqId, fieldEnumId, operatorEnumId, conditionValue), each an allowlisted field (CONDITION_FIELD_UNKNOWN), an operator it takes (CONDITION_OPERATOR_INVALID) and a value of its type (CONDITION_VALUE_INVALID). A field not given keeps the row's. Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the organization.

parameter.name: conditions
parameter.description: Maps of fieldEnumId, operatorEnumId and conditionValue

service.description: Puts a service team's user group (SVT_ and the team's id, made on first use; the audience of its saved replies, F3) in step with its current members: each of their users a current member, any other ended; and its organization's group (SVO_ and the organization's id; its service-wide replies) with the members of all its teams. save#ServiceTeam and save#ServiceTeamMember run it; internal, for loaded data.
A saved reply on a case: the text block, the agent's edit of its body and subject, and the mailbox.

parameter.name: bodyHtml
parameter.description: The body as the agent edited it; empty: the block's

service.description: A saved reply as it would go on a case (design SavedReplies ReplyPreview, CaseDetail CaseReplyAction): a text block the user may use (their own or shared with a group they are in) of the case's organization (REPLY_UNAVAILABLE); the subject and body with the case's values put in, and an error for a variable it does not know (UNSUPPORTED_VARIABLE) or one with no value on the case (UNRESOLVED_VARIABLE), never an empty value; the recipient (the case's contact, else its customer: RECIPIENT_REQUIRED with no email); the mailbox (SEND_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED); each action with whether it may run on the case now and why not; the case's revision. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and the case's organization.

Applies a saved reply on a case once the agent confirmed its preview: its actions (status, tag, assignee, priority, note, each through the case services' rules; a refused one refuses all) and, with send (the default), the reply as a draft in the user's mailbox sent through the mail client (send#EmailDraft), filed on the case when it is sent; all in one transaction. Refuses what preview#SavedReply names as an error and a case changed since caseRevision (STALE_CASE). The message keeps its pending or failed state by its emailMessageId (deliveryStatus pending, sent or failed). operationKey is required: a retry answers the first result, and sends a message whose send failed again, never a second reply. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and the case's organization.

A case template (design CaseTemplates TemplateEdit): a new one (a dated DbForm of the organization, purpose DbfpCaseTemplate) or its name and notes; with publish, its drafts start at fromDate (now or later), refused while it has a problem of validate#CaseTemplate (TEMPLATE_INVALID); with requestCategoryId, a service queue of its organization uses it from now (useForQueue, the default) or no longer does: a new ServiceQueue row, the current one ended (QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE; TEMPLATE_NOT_PUBLISHED before it is published). Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A template field: a new one is a draft (its name from its label unless newFieldName; never one of the case's own fields: FIELD_NAME_INVALID); a draft changes in place; a published field's label, help, required flag, order and options (lines of "value | label") change in place from now, audit-logged; a new type or audience, or a change from a later fromDate, is a successor field (a draft, or started at fromDate with the old one ended), so an answered field keeps its meaning. A typed allowlist: short and long text, a choice list, choice buttons, checkboxes and a date (FIELD_TYPE), a choice with options (OPTIONS_REQUIRED), the audience customer-visible or internal, and no expression in a label, help or option (NO_EXPRESSIONS). Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the template's organization.

A condition row of a template (design TemplateEdit's typed condition builder): show or require the target field while the source field is (equals) or is not (not-equals) one of the values, each one of its options, or is empty or filled in (the only conditions on a field that is not a choice: OPERATOR_INVALID, CONDITION_VALUE). A customer-visible field never depends on an internal one (CONDITION_AUDIENCE); a cycle (CONDITION_CYCLE) and a second rule of one effect on a field (CONDITION_DUPLICATE) are refused. Between published fields it starts now, and an edit ends the row and starts its replacement now; otherwise it is a draft. Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the template's organization.

Ends a template's field (part field, with its conditions), option (part option) or condition (part condition) at thruDate (now or later); a draft is deleted. Answers stay, and a case's values read the form as it was. Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the template's organization.

A template's checks as of a date, its drafts too unless includeDrafts is false (design TemplatePreview): its problems (no field, a type or text outside the allowlist, a choice with no option, a condition value its source does not offer, a customer field depending on an internal one, a cycle) and, for the sample values, what each audience sees, must fill in and has missing, with the messages (validate#TemplateValues). Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT or SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and the template's organization.

A case's template values on the server, as NewCase and the Support app submit them (F41), against the template as of asOfDate (now): evaluate#DbFormDependencies re-evaluates which fields show and which are required; a hidden field's value is dropped, a required one must be there (REQUIRED), each value is of its type (a choice one of the field's options then, a date, a text within its length), and for the customer's audience a value for an internal field is refused (FIELD_NOT_OFFERED). Answers the cleaned values and the errors; with refuse, an invalid submit is refused (TEMPLATE_VALUES_INVALID). Either audience needs the template's organization (P15 adds the customer contact's path).

A template as of asOfDate (now) for an audience: the customer's (audience customer) is its customer-visible fields only, with their options and the rules among them, never a draft or an internal field (the Support app's form, P15), and needs the template's organization (P15 adds the customer contact's path); the agent's (internal) has every field and needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT or SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and the template's organization, and with includeDrafts (SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT) the editor's rows: every field, option and condition not ended, with its state, and the template's problems.

A case's template values as submitted, with the form as it was at the response date (its labels and option texts then); the customer's audience leaves out every internal field. The case must be one of the user's organizations' (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A queue's route (design ChannelRouting RouteEdit) from its date, ending the route it replaces (the same channel, queue and mail account, or forum site and category): the channel (SrcEmail, SrcWebForm, SrcForum, SrcChat: CHANNEL_INVALID), for mail its account (ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE), for the forum its site (SITE_REQUIRED) and category (FORUM_CATEGORY_UNAVAILABLE; one queue per site and category: ROUTE_EXISTS), the type the queue offers (TYPE_NOT_OFFERED), priority (PRIORITY_INVALID), the unknown-sender rule (empty: the policy's), the automatic-mail rule (attach, the default, or ignore), whether a new case is acknowledged, with which text block (TEXT_BLOCK_UNAVAILABLE) and identity (IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE), the public form's hourly limit and its token's life in days. With end, ends the route. Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the queue's organization.

A dry run of a message to a queue (design ChannelRouting RouteTest), writing nothing: the route it takes, the request its references or a verified case token join, whether it is automatic, who the sender is to the organization (customer, staff, other, unknown), and the outcome (join, case, held for review, ignore) with the type, priority and whether it is acknowledged. Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT or SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE and the queue's organization (QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); refuses no sender (SENDER_REQUIRED).

A call on a case (design ChannelSessions LogCall): a Phone communication event filed on it, in from or out to the case's contact (its reporter, else its customer, or the one given: CONTACT_UNAVAILABLE), when it was (not ahead: DATE_INVALID), how long (DURATION_INVALID), the summary (SUMMARY_REQUIRED) and the outcome (CaseCallOutcome: OUTCOME_INVALID). An internal call (internal Y) is not customer-visible; it and a call that reached no one (no answer, voicemail) never meet first response. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and the case's organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A request held for review in a service queue (mail or the public form from staff, another party or an unknown sender; F62): accept makes it a case for the customer given, else its sender, who takes the Customer role (CUSTOMER_REQUIRED for a staff sender; CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE for a customer not served); dismiss cancels it with the reason. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and the queue's organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); refuses a request that is not held (NOT_HELD) and another decision (DECISION_INVALID).

parameter.name: sourceRequestIds
parameter.description: The cases merged into it (at most 10)

service.description: What a merge would do (design MergeCases MergeSelection, MergePreview), writing nothing: each case's subject, customer, queue, status, assignee, participants, messages by audience, files, work, linked records and clocks, the clocks each source would carry (an open one as an obligation on the kept case, due as it was; a breach kept), the problems that stop it, each naming its case (CASE_MERGED, CASE_CLOSED, TARGET_NOT_OPEN, ORGANIZATION_MISMATCH, CUSTOMER_MISMATCH: another customer's duplicate is only linked), and the case revisions to confirm with. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE and every case of the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); refuses no source (SOURCE_REQUIRED), the kept case among the sources (SAME_CASE) and more than 10 (TOO_MANY_CASES).

Merges cases into the case kept (design MergeCases MergeConfirm), atomically: every case locked, each source's relation (CrtMerge) with the reason and its items; its messages referenced on the kept case with their audience and times unchanged, its records and work linked to it, its files listed; each open clock of a source carried as an obligation, its breach kept, the kept case's own clocks untouched; the source cancelled as a duplicate when open, and closed, so its changes are refused naming the kept case (CASE_MERGED) and a reply to it goes to the kept case. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE, the cases of the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one customer and organization and no problem of preview#MergeCases (its code, naming the case), a reason (REASON_REQUIRED) and an operation key (OPERATION_KEY_REQUIRED; a retry answers the first result); a case changed since its revision is refused naming the current one (STALE_CASE).

parameter.name: caseRevisions
parameter.description: The revisions the merge was previewed at: a map by case, or text "id:revision,id:revision" (preview#MergeCases' caseRevisions)

parameter.name: communicationEventIds
parameter.description: Its messages the new case takes

parameter.name: recordKeys
parameter.description: Its linked records the new case takes, each "recordEntityName|recordId"

service.description: What a split would take (design SplitCase SplitSelection), writing nothing: the source's messages (oldest first), linked records, work and files, each with its audience and whether it is chosen, and when the new case's clock would start (the earliest chosen message's receipt, else now). Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT, the case of the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), open (CASE_NOT_OPEN) and not merged (CASE_MERGED); refuses a chosen item not on it (EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE).

A new case from some of a case's evidence (design SplitCase SplitNewCase), atomically: the source's customer, contact and organization, the subject (NAME_REQUIRED), type, queue (one of the organization's: QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE, TYPE_NOT_OFFERED), priority (PRIORITY_INVALID) and description given; its clocks from the earliest chosen message's receipt, or from a start a manager gives with its reason (SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE, START_REASON_REQUIRED, DATE_INVALID for a time ahead), else now; assigned by the queue's rules unless an assignee is given (ASSIGNEE_UNAVAILABLE); no template values unless they are given (then checked: TEMPLATE_VALUES_INVALID). The chosen messages are referenced on it with their audience (the same customer reads both cases), records and work linked, files listed; the relation (CrtSplit) and its items; the source stays open. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT (another agent's case SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE), the case of the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), open and not merged, an operation key (a retry answers the first result) and its revision (STALE_CASE).

parameter.name: intakeDate
parameter.description: A manager's start of the new case's clocks

service.description: An agent's follow-up case of a closed or cancelled case, or one past its reopen window (design StatusCategories: a cancelled case is only followed up): the same customer, organization and contact, the case's queue while it is one, assigned by its rules, linked by the relation (CrtFollowUp). Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and the case of the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); refuses an open case (CASE_OPEN), one that can still be reopened (CASE_REOPENABLE) and a merged one (CASE_MERGED).

Internal, after the commit of a customer's reply on a closed or cancelled case (or one past its reopen window; Sla.js recordMessage, CaseRelations.js replyArrived): the follow-up case with the reply on it, once per reply; a later reply joins the follow-up still open.

A case's lineage (design CaseDetail's lineage): each relation from or to it (merged into or from, split into or from, followed up by or a follow-up of) with the other case, who, when, why and its items with their audience; the case it was merged into (its redirect); whether it is closed, cancelled or resolved, may still be reopened (the reopen window) or followed up, and whether it is still worked (actionable). A case of the user's organizations only (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Auto-close (the close_ResolvedCases ServiceJob; design ServiceDefaults, CS-JOBS): for each organization whose ServicePolicy in effect has an auto-close delay (autoCloseDays), a bounded batch (limit, 200) of its cases resolved longer ago than that and not closed, oldest first; each in its own transaction (close#ResolvedCase) gets CaseProfile.closedDate and keeps ReqCompleted, after which a reply makes a follow-up case. A case that fails is logged and named in failedList and the rest go on, and one with a clock still running is named without taking a place in the batch (CLOCK_OPEN); a rerun changes nothing.

parameter.name: requestIds
parameter.description: Only these cases (a walk's own), else every organization's

service.description: Internal, for close#ResolvedCases: one case, locked, closed when it is still Completed, not closed and resolved longer ago than the delay, in the caller's new transaction; a resolved case with a clock still running is refused (CLOCK_OPEN), never closed.
